sources.Section: Sardinien 2019 / Lokaler Hochkant-Prüfschnitt v18 – Einstieg und Film-CTA / Evidenz- und Abnahmeübersicht v18
sources.OriginalText: | Plattform-Link / Privacy | Upload-ID `9VvgwP4sxHw`; Studio zeigt „Public“ und „Related video: Sardinia round trip in 2019“; öffentlicher Short zeigt Link zu `1tdn5NKrl4M`, Klick erreicht diese Film-URL. Fertiger Export über den ganzen Verlauf als 5-fps-Kontaktbögen und in relevanten Bereichen mit 720×1280-Einzelbildern visuell geprüft; keine fremden Personen, Kinder oder Kennzeichen erkannt. Keine Behauptung einer Einzelkontrolle aller 666 Frames. | `PRIVACY_APPROVED` für v18; öffentlich und Link live geprüft |

sources.Section: Sardinien 2019 / Lokaler Hochkant-Prüfschnitt v18 – Einstieg und Film-CTA / Evidenz- und Abnahmeübersicht v18
sources.OriginalText: Abnahme: v18 wurde nach Helmuts Verifizierung veröffentlicht. YouTubes Upload-Check meldete keine Copyright-Probleme. `https://www.youtube.com/shorts/9VvgwP4sxHw` war am 2026-09-24 gegen 22:03 MESZ öffentlich abrufbar; der eingeblendete Related-Video-Link führte zu `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1tdn5NKrl4M`. Kein Web-Service-Rollout und kein Neustart: Veröffentlichungsziel war ausschließlich YouTube.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo
sources.OriginalText: Use this skill for photo edits intended for the VanVenture website.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Preserve the documentary original
sources.OriginalText: - Edit an existing photo; never regenerate its scene.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Preserve the documentary original
sources.OriginalText: - Preserve people, faces, body proportions, expression, clothing, equipment, vehicles, animals, landscape, and composition exactly.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Preserve the documentary original
sources.OriginalText: - Do not add, move, replace, crop, reshape, or remove pictured elements, except for approved privacy work or explicitly approved distraction removal.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Preserve the documentary original
sources.OriginalText: - Treat every AI-assisted result as a review derivative. Compare it visually with the unchanged project copy before publication. Do not use it as the sole retained source.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Privacy and source handling
sources.OriginalText: - Archive originals are read-only. First retain an unchanged project copy and record the source path and checksum when an archive original is used.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Privacy and source handling
sources.OriginalText: - VanVenture person rule (user decision, 24 September 2026): Anonymize recognizable children. Anonymize an adult's face only when the user explicitly asks for that particular photo; do not routinely mask adults. Helmut and Sabine may remain recognizable. If age or publication permission is unclear, hold the affected image and ask the user explicitly. This rule is project-local. A still-recognizable child must not be published without explicit selection of that photo.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Privacy and source handling
sources.OriginalText: - Anonymize every visible vehicle license plate. Where face masking is specifically authorized, fit the mask closely to identifying facial features with a small safety margin and soft feathered edges. Prefer localized Gaussian blur over coarse blocks. Do not cover hair, clothing, bodies, or background unnecessarily. Verify unreadability at 100% and at every rendered size. Faces turned away with no identifying detail need no mask.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Privacy and source handling
sources.OriginalText: - Do not publish recognizable children unless the user explicitly selects the photo.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Distraction removal requires confirmation
sources.OriginalText: - Identify human-made distractions such as power lines, poles, fences, bins, or barriers.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Distraction removal requires confirmation
sources.OriginalText: - Do not remove them until the user explicitly confirms the exact elements. Keep them unchanged in the first grading pass.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Distraction removal requires confirmation
sources.OriginalText: - After confirmation, remove only the named elements in a local project derivative. Inspect repaired pixels at 100% for seams, repeated patterns, or collateral scene changes; keep adjacent structures and objects unless separately approved.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Print-magazine grade
sources.OriginalText: - Use natural, earthy color. Keep greens moody but plausible; slightly desaturate sky/water blues; subtly support warm browns and oranges.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Print-magazine grade
sources.OriginalText: - Apply controlled filmic contrast and a gently raised, matte black point. Preserve realistic highlight and shadow detail.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Print-magazine grade
sources.OriginalText: - Preserve real skin texture and midday/daylight character. Avoid beauty retouching, HDR, artificial bokeh, dramatic relighting, oversaturation, or invented golden-hour light.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Print-magazine grade
sources.OriginalText: - Tune the grade to the individual photograph; do not apply fixed numeric settings indiscriminately. Keep greens moody but plausible, slightly desaturate sky/water blues, and subtly support warm browns/oranges without changing the scene's natural daylight character.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Delivery
sources.OriginalText: - Save derivatives alongside the relevant project assets without overwriting the unchanged source.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Delivery
sources.OriginalText: - Before publishing, confirm the visual result respects the original and that all plates are anonymized.

sources.Section: Outdoor Editorial Photo / Delivery
sources.OriginalText: - Compare privacy masks and any distraction repair against the unchanged project copy at full resolution; retain the source hash, derivative hash, exact operation notes, and review status. AI-assisted derivatives remain review-only until explicitly approved.
